data_fields.name: chaseSeconds
data_fields.donor_constant: 0.15 of the gap closed per update, no time term (frame-based)

data_fields.name: exitBand
data_fields.donor_constant: none in donor: entry and exit share one threshold

data_fields.name: snapEpsilon
data_fields.donor_constant: precision x target in deprecated smoothLerp (zero at target 0, so no snap)

best_idea: A health display that chases the true value on elapsed time, while the winning and losing icons read the true value at fixed thresholds with an exit band.
decision_why: Two values (shown versus true) and threshold icons fit a client-only HUD under one ledger; the donor's per-frame chase, shared entry and exit threshold, and non-snapping helper are fixed in the sketch.
acceptance: After a 40 percent hit the bar fill slides down over about 0.5 s at both 30 and 60 fps; the losing icon starts below 20 percent and does not flicker within a 5 percent band; a unit test asserts the displayed value after one second agrees at 30 and 60 updates per second within 0.01.
